_comment: The XTX machine (docs/REFERENCE-MACHINES.md). Values that differ from OpenCore's Sample.plist, by stage. Each stage starts from the one named in 'inherits' and adds to it. SMBIOS serials are NOT here: build.py reads them from ~/.config/vermilion/smbios-<machine>.json.
name: ASUS ROG STRIX B650E-I + Ryzen 9 7900X3D + RX 7900 XTX
_acpi: SSDT-CPUR: the firmware declares CPUs only as ACPI0007 devices; macOS needs Processor () objects (24, matching the MADT's enabled IDs). See the table's header.
_dsdt_fix: Replacing the DSDT with a recompiled, resolved copy (fix_dsdt.py resolve) loaded cleanly but did not get past the CoreAnalyticsHub hang (third boot, 2026-11-18). Replaced by in-place NOP patches below, the method proven on other ASUS AM5 boards (nullmoth/1401 issue 21).

acpi_patches.comment: DSDT BIOS 4005 line 12901 @0x0ED92: unconditional chipset PCIe tree (If (G002 != 3 && G000 == 1)); 26/26 devices present under Linux
DSDT BIOS 4005 line 13497 @0x0F812: unconditional chipset xHCI + ports (If (G002 != 3 && G000 == 1 && G004 != 0x43FA1022)); 18/18 present
DSDT BIOS 4005 line 15053 @0x10E80: unconditional DP20.NV00 (If (... && G002 != 5)); 1/1 present
DSDT BIOS 4005 line 15079 @0x10EE3: unconditional DP00.NV00 (If (... && G002 != 6)); 1/1 present
DSDT BIOS 4005 line 15461 @0x113C2: unconditional DP40.EP00 (If (G002 != 3 && G000 == 1 && G002 != 4 && G003 == 0)); 1/1 present

_acpi_patches: Each Find is an If header (opcode A0, PkgLength, predicate) in the firmware DSDT, replaced by the same number of NOPs (A3): the block body then runs while the table loads, as on Linux. The blocks are the ones whose devices all exist under Linux on BIOS 4005 (fix_dsdt.py resolve plan). build.py checks each Find occurs exactly once in the dumped DSDT. Re-derive after a BIOS update.

booter_quirks._DisableVariableWrite: Ryzen 7000/8000/9000 boards hang when the macOS installer writes firmware variables (freeze at ~12-19 minutes remaining, 2026-11-19). Fix from nullmoth/1401 docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md and issue 21.
booter_quirks._ResizeAppleGpuBars: 0 = macOS sees the GPU BARs at their default sizes (BAR0 256 MiB) while Resizable BAR stays on in the BIOS for Linux. Vermilion maps BAR0 as a VRAM window and was validated with 256 MiB (src/vermilion-boot/phx_core.cpp). OpenCore 1.0.8 accepts only -1 or 0 here.

kernel_patches.comment: Pike R. Alpha | AGDP board-id -> board-ix (agdpmod=pikera without WhateverGreen) | 26+

_kernel_patches: Navi (RDNA) cards need agdpmod=pikera or they hang/black-screen when the graphics stack takes over (stall after 'IOG flags 0x3 (0x51)', 2026-11-19). WhateverGreen breaks on macOS 26 (Dortania Tahoe page), so this is the same rename as a kernel patch, exactly as nullmoth/1401 p1401/policy.py PIKERA_PATCH does for AMD dGPUs on Tahoe.
_uefi_drivers: --preserve-boot: the picker's Reset NVRAM keeps the firmware boot entries (Limine, OpenCore). Without it a reset wiped them all on 2026-11-18.

install._comment: Phase 1 first boot and the macOS install: the fewest kexts that boot, SIP on, verbose.

base._comment: Phase 1 after the install: Wi-Fi, then the rest of the machine, one change per boot. Wi-Fi: AirportMtkWlan 2.1.6 loaded but never attached to the card (boot 1, 2026-11-19); MtkWirelessWifi 1.1.1 since then (findings/2026-11-19-wifi-mt7922.md).
base._boot_args_add: pci=0x8000000 = kIOPCIConfiguratorDefaultETF (IOPCIFamily-726 IOPCIConfigurator.h): macOS keeps the firmware's extended/10-bit tag settings. Without it IOPCIBridge::probeBusGated sets 10-Bit Tag Requester Enable on the GPP7 root port (Linux leaves it off), and the MT7922 and I225-V, the only chipset endpoints without 10-bit tag completer support, stop answering (2026-11-19, findings/2026-11-19-wifi-mt7922.md). AMD_Vanilla's 'Disable 10 bit tags' patch is enabled but the bit was set anyway.

vermilion._comment: Phase 2: Vermilion (docs/INSTALL.md section 1). Needs build/VermilionBoot.kext from the macOS build host. Inherited install from 2026-11-19 (GPU first, Wi-Fi untested); re-parented onto base on 2026-11-19 for the Wi-Fi test, so the booted stage gets AirportMtkWlan and nothing else changes.

vermilion-pcilog._comment: Diagnostics, one boot at a time: vermilion + IOPCIFamily's own logging (pci_log_mode 0x6 = IOLog + os_log, which also prints 'config protect fail'; pci_log 0x677 = AER, init, power, config, state, interrupt, enumeration, life cycle). Logging only, no behaviour change. Added 2026-11-19 because the MT7922 and the I225-V get an empty capability list (findings/2026-11-19-wifi-mt7922.md).
